name: Jason Duval
bio: After a stint in the Army, Jason landed in the Leonida Keys working for local drug runners — practical, capable, and trying to keep his head down until he meets Lucia.

details.background: Former military, turned to a life of crime after struggling to find work. Now runs with local drug runners in the Leonida Keys.
details.personality: Calm, tactical, and loyal. Drawing inspiration from figures like Clyde Barrow.

name: Lucia Caminos
bio: Lucia grew up in Liberty City before ending up in Leonida, where she was incarcerated at the Leonida Penitentiary for an unspecified crime tied to 'fighting for her family.'

details.background: Grew up in Liberty City, ended up incarcerated in Leonida. First major non-optional female protagonist in mainline GTA.
details.personality: Bold, cunning, driven by ambition and a desire for the good life her mother once dreamed of.

name: Boobie Ike
bio: A Vice City figure who turned street hustle into a legitimate-looking empire spanning real estate, the Jack of Hearts strip club, and Only Raw Records.

details.background: Built empire from street hustle — real estate, Jack of Hearts strip club, Only Raw Records (co-founded with Dre'Quan Priest).
details.personality: All smiles until it's time to talk business.

name: Cal Hampton
bio: Jason's paranoid, beer-loving best friend who monitors Coast Guard radio frequencies from home.

details.background: Jason's best friend. Spends his time monitoring Coast Guard radio with a few beers and private browser tabs.

name: Dre'Quan Priest
bio: A former street dealer who traded crime for the music business. Works with Boobie Ike at Only Raw Records.

details.background: Former street dealer turned music executive at Only Raw Records. Signed the duo Real Dimez.

name: Real Dimez (Bae-Luxe & Roxy)
bio: A rap duo, friends since high school, who went from shaking down local dealers to building a music career and social-media following.

details.background: High school friends who built a music career. Signed to Only Raw Records.

name: Raul Bautista
bio: A seasoned bank robber who combines charm with a serious appetite for risk, always looking for his next big score.

details.background: Seasoned bank robber with a charm for high-risk scores.
details.personality: Charming, risk-taking, always hunting the next big score.

name: Brian Heder
bio: Lets Jason live rent-free in exchange for shakedown help. A Keys-based drug runner and smuggler.

details.background: Drug runner and smuggler based in the Leonida Keys.

name: Stefanie
bio: A correctional social worker at the Leonida Department of Corrections — the first voice heard in GTA 6's marketing.

details.background: Correctional social worker at Leonida Department of Corrections. First voice in Trailer 1.

name: Andrés de León
bio: A wealthy media executive tied to 'Megamundo'. Jason and Lucia work security for him before the job turns chaotic.

details.background: Wealthy media executive connected to Megamundo. Hires Jason and Lucia for security.
